counterexample: Exactness holds (99/99), but the commutative-semigroup method reaches only x62 (mult mod 3) and x77 (min) at L = 1024, t = 10^5, while the affine and fuse methods are already 1.4-6.4x faster at t = 100 for every L in {256, 1024, 4096} (EXP-C15-03; indicative timings).
statement: Each of the affine, commutative-semigroup and fuse fast-forwards is exact, beats direct numpy simulation by more than 100x at L = 1024, t = 10^5, and loses for t below a few hundred steps.
title: H-C15-6: every exact fast-forward beats simulation by more than 100x at L = 1024, t = 10^5 and loses for small t (refuted)
